lines.text: Many learners say: She very pretty.
Describing words need is, am or are.
Is very! My sister is very kind.

data.why: Describing words need is, am or are.

native.hook: 形容词前面别漏掉 is！
native.tip: 中文可以说“她很漂亮”，但英语用形容词描述主语时，前面要有 is/am/are。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “She very pretty.”？😅 中文里“她很漂亮”不用动词，英语的形容词前面却要有 is/am/are：“She is very pretty.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“She is very pretty.”免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: In English, an adjective needs is, am or are before it.
en.caption: Do you say “She very pretty.”? 😅 In English, an adjective needs is, am or are before it: “She is very pretty.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
